name: 10pines-c17-customerimporter-1
title: Customer Importer 1: test it and decouple it from the file
description: A legacy god method Customer class>>importCustomers reads customers and addresses from a CSV file into a simulated database session, with two hidden bugs and one assertion-less test. The student must move it under a real test (set-up/tear-down for the session, assertions on the two imported customers and their addresses), fix the bugs, parameterize the input stream and the session, and turn it into a method object.

design.notes: Characterization-test iteration: the difficulty is breaking the dependencies of a god method (file, database session, transaction) with small safe refactorings (extract to setUp/tearDown, introduce parameter, generalize the file stream to a ReadStream, method object) before touching its logic, and writing declarative assertions that reveal the two field-index bugs.
